body.en:
Rei is one of the best pure Damage Buffers in the game
Void, Basics, Multi Hit and 1 cost or lower are her buff Synergies
Rei usually increases damage through Additive Damage Increases
Additive Damage Increases have amazing synergy with Multi Hit/Attack Spam
Examples:
Chizuru Oni 1 Base
50% x 4 = 200%
But with a 40% Additve Damage Increases from Rei
(50%+40%) x 4 = 360%, from only 40% Additive, a 1.8x Damage Increase!
While 40% Multplicative Damage would only be
(50%x140%) x4 = 280% from 40% Multiplicative, only 1.4x Damage Increase
Rei is Capable of a huge ammount of Additive Damage Increase
60/40% from Resonating Darkness
150-50% from Resonating Darkness
80% from 4 Moral
290% for a Multi hit Attack or 140% Permanently Possible before Dupes

text.en: [Exhaust] Heal 150%. Select and Exhaust up to 2 card(s) in hand, then Draw for each Exhausted.

body.en:
Rei's other strength is her ability to Deck Thin
Rei's Snacktime is capable of Exhausting Cards
Exhaust means the card will be gone for the rest of the Combat
Snacktime means you can keep bad cards like Basics, but just get rid of them
Exhausting 2 cards with Snacktime is strong
Example:
Your 24 card deck after Exhausting 3 (2+Itself) means you have a 21 card deck
The only possible problem with Snacktime, is it isn't a card positive usually
Example:
5 Cards in hand
2 Cards in hand, Snacktime Exhausts 3 (2+Itself) 5-3
4 Cards in hand, Snacktime draws 2 2 + 2
-1 Card in hand compared to before Snacktime
You need supplemental Card positive draw most times
Upgrade and Retain can also mean Exhaust
